lines.text: Many disciples called His teaching difficult, and Jesus, aware of their grumbling, asked whether it offended them.
Jesus said the Spirit gives life, the flesh profits nothing, and His words are spirit and life.
Jesus said no one can come to Him unless the Law has granted it to him.
Many disciples turned back, but Simon Peter told Jesus the Twelve believed He is the Prophet like Moses.
Jesus said one of the Twelve was a devil, meaning Judas, son of Simon Iscariot, who would betray Him.
